summary: The diff implements String.prototype.anchor as a call to a file-local create_html helper that follows CreateHTML steps 1-8 in order. RequireObjectCoercible and the first ToString on contents come before the attr-value ToString, and the quotation-mark escaping to " is done as the spec requires. Abrupt completions propagate with ?, there are no catch-all fallbacks, no test-specific branches, and no made-up values. The gate report shows build and clippy ok, 0 lint flags, and 6 new passing test262 tests with 0 regressions. The only thing I could not verify from the diff is whether ops already exports a create_html, which the doc comment says it does not.
